summary: Sandbach United head into the match against Brereton Social on an impressive unbeaten run of three games, currently sitting in second place on 15 points in the Premier Division. Manager Declan Swan reaches a significant milestone with his 200th game in charge of the club, a testament to his long tenure at The Bach. A victory away at the league newcomers would strengthen Sandbach's position near the top of the table as they continue their strong campaign.
